_about: The Bayeux tapestry palette for the menu chrome, sampled from photographs of the real tapestry (../ctc-journal/img/look/ref/ref01, ref05, ref07: 13-pixel box averages on linen, wool fills and outlines, lifted slightly where the photo is dim). tools/look/tapestry_svgs.mjs reads it to draw web/look/*.svg; web/theme.css repeats the same values as custom properties. When notes/look/stitch/ lands with its own sampled palette, align both here.
